scope: Read-only source review after phone feedback: reading and settings both feel uneven; not a measured device cause or performance acceptance
findings: InfiniteScrollView.scrollViewDidScroll updates viewports/preload and notifies the navigator on every scroll callback.
Navigator infiniteScrollViewDidUpdateViews forwards to updateCurrentLocation except automatic-scroll mode.

Readium 3.11 execute() ignores additional calls while polling a false idle condition; it does not serialize an already-running async block once the condition is true. This makes overlapping DOM location work a concrete profiling hypothesis, not a measured phone root cause.
ReaderViewModel position emissions publish shared state and persist each emitted position; no per-frame write-rate measurement was obtained.
Build27 stops preview upscaling and removes unbounded inline imported-font views; font parsing remains in a bounded actor.
nextMeasurement: Release on phone: sustained continuous reading vs paged mode, first/repeated settings browsing; measure main/render frame time and outstanding DOM sample count. If redundant samples are confirmed, use latest-request single-flight/trailing coalescing with final fresh full-anchor save and cancellation/reopen regressions, not dropped final positions.
